record.question: Under the PCPNDT Act, pre-natal diagnostic techniques shall not be conducted except for the purpose of detection of which of the following abnormalities?
record.explanation: Section 4(2) of the PCPNDT Act lists detection of haemoglobinopathies, sex-linked genetic diseases and congenital anomalies among its permitted diagnostic purposes, subject to the Act’s other conditions. All three offered abnormalities are included; this does not authorize sex selection. Reference: https://upload.indiacode.nic.in/view-casepdf?id=AC_CEN_12_13_00013_199457_1517807323443&type=act. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
